title: Floral & Citrus
summary: Orange blossom, rose, lemongrass, kaffir lime — use sparingly; aroma is not volume.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — floral & citrus is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: citrus, floral_herb, sweet. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Salt and acid ground floral notes so they taste food, not perfume.
